system.description: Time halts. You move; everything else does not. At the edge of your vision, figures stand watching.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, but you take two extra turns.
outcomes.success: You take one extra turn while the world stands still. You cannot harm or affect other creatures, but you may move, reload, ready yourself or take unattended items.
outcomes.failure: Time only stutters: you are Quickened.
outcomes.ruin: The watchers notice you. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
